nodes.name: Webhook — Receive Reminder
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives: {title, description, reminder_datetime (ISO 8601), user_id, timezone}

nodes.name: Google Calendar — Create Event
nodes.notes: Creates event on Google Calendar. Triggers native phone push notification at reminder time (no polling needed).

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "action_id": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Datetime').item.json.reminder_id }}",
  "status": "confirmed",
  "event": "reminder_created",
  "gcal_event_id": "{{ $json.id }}",
  "gcal_html_link": "{{ $json.htmlLink }}",
  "title": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Datetime').item.json.title }}",
  "reminder_datetime": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Datetime').item.json.reminder_datetime }}",
  "confirm_message": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Datetime').item.json.confirm_message }}",
  "user_id": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Datetime').item.json.user_id }}"
}

nodes.name: Callback — Reminder Created
nodes.notes: Notifies backend immediately that the reminder was created. Backend updates state to CONFIRMED and triggers TTS confirmation.

nodes.name: Wait Until Reminder Time
nodes.notes: n8n pauses execution until the exact reminder datetime. No polling. Execution resumes automatically when time is up.

nodes.name: Callback — Reminder Fired
nodes.notes: Calls backend when reminder fires. Backend will: 1) trigger TTS to speak the reminder aloud, 2) publish MQTT to ESP32 (alert LEDs + audio)
